scoreMethod: Synthetic example only. The live score uses the documented weighted finding counts.

notes: Synthetic example; not data from a real computer.

findings.title: Low free space on C:
findings.explanation: Free space is below the scanner's 10% threshold.
findings.recommendedAction: Review Windows Storage settings and remove only files you recognize and no longer need.

findings.title: Large old file candidate
findings.explanation: A large file is older than six months; its content was not opened.
findings.evidence: One file over 512 MB and older than 180 days.
findings.recommendedAction: Check whether it is needed and backed up before moving or deleting it.
findings.classification: Cleanup candidate, not a confirmed problem

notes: Folder metadata scan is synthetic in this sample.

findings.title: Low available physical memory at sample time
findings.explanation: Available RAM is low and may increase paging.
findings.recommendedAction: Retest during normal use and close only applications you recognize; consider an upgrade only if this remains persistent.
findings.classification: Confirmed snapshot; persistent pressure needs retesting

findings.title: Many startup entries are configured
findings.explanation: A large startup list can increase sign-in time.
findings.recommendedAction: Review known non-essential apps in Windows Settings → Apps → Startup; do not disable drivers or security items.
